title: Lanternfish
description: Model exponential lanternfish population growth using timer buckets.
writeup:
## Approach

The key insight is that individual fish don't matter — only how many fish share each timer value. Tracking 9 buckets (timers 0-8) instead of billions of individual fish makes the simulation O(days) instead of O(population).

## Part 1

Simulate 80 days. Each day, shift all buckets left (decrement timers). Fish at timer 0 spawn new fish at timer 8 and reset to timer 6. Count total fish.

## Part 2

Same simulation for 256 days. Without the bucket optimization, the population would be too large to track individually (~1.7 trillion fish). With buckets, it's just 256 iterations of 9-element array shifts.
